[b]The Great Parliamentary Assembly - 11th April 2025[/b]

Voices echoed across the chamber as the ministers of Hydronia assembled once again. This time they had assembled not to discuss new legislation, but to discuss Thývens recent developments.

One day earlier, a THEP meeting had been held, where Thýven threatened tariffs if their goals of complete unification where not met. When the president and his Defense minister returned from the meeting, President Zorlu immediately called a meeting with his cabinet. In this meeting they discussed potential courses of action and came to the decision that Hydronia would take part in a THEP confederation if one was ever negotiated, but Hydronia would not stand for excessive tariffs coming from their allies. The minister of foreign affairs is now presenting a policy to allow the governments plan of action to go ahead, authorising the formation of a possible THEP confederation.

You really want to give up our sovereignty to country that still retains an oppressive monarchy! Shouted Far-right leader Dural Agca.
They do NOT retain any kind of oppressive regime, they have a monarchy due to tradition and its their choice whether they keep it, not ours, replied Halis Erdemir, minister of foreign affairs.
And what are you going to do about the tariffs, youre allowing us to be bullied into submission! Shouted Dural.
SHUT YOUR MOUTH YOU FASCIST FOOL! Cried an unknown voice from Kaplans side of the room, provoking anger from the right.
SILENCE! Shouted the president, trying to calm down the assembly m. Eventually the noise lowered and the debate began again.
It is in our best interests to form a confederation and if not that then to create closer ties within THEP. This is not because of any tariffs imposed on us, but because THEP is unorganised. Even with the Security Council implemented, we need more unity. All we want to do is pass legislation that would authorise the THEP ministry to take part in actions that satisfy our needs of unity. These actions could be forming a confederation or simply lower border restrictions. Said Erdemir, trying to convince the other side. After hours of intense debate a vote was held. The legislation passed, with Zorlus party along with the Eco alliance voting for the legislation and the right wing parties voting against. The legislation passed swiftly through the house of governors with no amendments being made to it.

Even though the legislation had passed, The president still felt that more needed to be discussed, so he called another cabinet meeting after the parliament session. During this meeting, they discussed the behaviour of Thývens new king, Erjk. They discussed his behavioural changes from his mothers rule and the possibility that he is attempting to control Hydronia and the rest of THEP. Thýven is a powerful ally, so they decided it would be best to simply observe for now and try to stay on the good side of Erjk.

The plane was highly decorated with golden patterns stretching from nose to tail, silver sigils painted into the hull of the aircraft, and an emblem of a rampant dragon positioned on the tail of the plane. Once the plane came to a stop the doors slowly lowered and revealed a brightly lit and golden interior, with more sigils of dragons embedded on the walls.
